title: Languages in a fixed AC level
statement: For a natural number $d$, a language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet belongs to the $d$th AC level if there is a well-formed family of directed acyclic circuit graphs computing $L$, whose size is bounded by a polynomial in the input length and whose depth is bounded by a polynomial in the logarithm of the input length, with the depth bound determined by $d$.
hypotheses_covered: A language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet
